scope: Review full PDFs and existing extraction for every flagged paper, including all its segments; emit source-backed correction proposals rather than rewriting the raw extraction.

observed_narrow_sol_audit.scope: Outcome extremes only; much narrower than reviewing whole extraction.

planning_eta.notes: ETA is a planning assumption, not a measured full-review throughput. Depends on account token/rate limits and dependent repairs. Prior complete Sol extractions took roughly 8–11 minutes per paper; narrow audit median 13.5 seconds. Full review falls between these workloads.

limitations: Existing input counts include the previous extraction schema, so reusing them is conservative for PDF input.
Existing extraction text uses a 3–5 character/token estimate, not a provider token count.
Output sizes are scenarios; full re-extraction would be substantially more expensive.
Cache retention, rate limits, actual output/reasoning and retries may change cost. No new review has been started.
